findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: switchboard_asset_get, switchboard_live_feed, switchboard_chunk, switchboard_delayed, switchboard_long_show, switchboard_media, switchboard_live_open, switchboard_live_extend, switchboard_credit_topup · Private data: switchboard_source_get, switchboard_job_get, switchboard_asset_get, switchboard_card_balance, switchboard_card_orders, switchboard_card_topup_ticket, switchboard_dante_glasses_bind, switchboard_dante_glasses_frame, switchboard_credit_topup · Public sink: switchboard_source_open, switchboard_source_finish, switchboard_source_cancel, switchboard_source_get, switchboard_live_say, switchboard_broadcast_pack, switchboard_media · Destructive: switchboard_source_cancel.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: switchboard_asset_get, switchboard_live_feed, switchboard_chunk, switchboard_delayed, switchboard_long_show, switchboard_media, switchboard_live_open, switchboard_live_extend, switchboard_credit_topup · Private data: switchboard_source_get, switchboard_job_get, switchboard_asset_get, switchboard_card_balance, switchboard_card_orders, switchboard_card_topup_ticket, switchboard_dante_glasses_bind, switchboard_dante_glasses_frame, switchboard_credit_topup · Public sink: switchboard_source_open, switchboard_source_finish, switchboard_source_cancel, switchboard_source_get, switchboard_live_say, switchboard_broadcast_pack, switchboard_media · Destructive: switchboard_source_cancel

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
